markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (76%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability flag is set, the MUSK model disagrees, and Invasive stays in the conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 76%, Invasive 15%, Normal 9% | InSitu leads; Invasive second |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.63 / 78th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top class not confirmed |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu | Neighbors mostly disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Benign tissue linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest negative concept term, but spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Scored high in these regions; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood; spot check 12/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0. Not shown to reflect classifier use. Normal lobules and necrosis are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The image is blurred or off-stain; reliability 0.63 is flagged, so probabilities may be off.
- Necrosis and normal-lobule scores are artefacts; both failed spot checks.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 7, 2, 6**: highest invasive contributions; look for stromal invasion versus intact duct borders.
2. **Region 10**: top tile for necrosis and duct-confined atypia; confirm necrosis is real.
3. **Region 4**: top tile for infiltrating stroma and pleomorphism; assess for invasion.
